title: ES/EN query expansion (Anchored)
resolution: ceiling measured with Gemini 3.8 Flash translations of every question run as a second word-lane pass (`evaluations/expansion-2026-10-15/`, `expansion-*.log`): acceptance R 0.40 to 0.42, holdout 0.52 to 0.51, MRR unchanged on both. A glossary would do worse than a perfect translation, and a translation per prompt costs a model call.
